statement: For every original orthonormal pair, its actual P=Lambda(|A1><A1|) and Q=Lambda(|A2><A2|) are incomparable in the Loewner order: P-Q has at least one strictly positive and one strictly negative eigenvalue. Thus neither P<=Q nor Q<=P is available as a general route from the automatic coCP block to the required q3 block.
written_proof: On M4, Tr Phi(X)=(7/2)Tr X, so Tr Lambda(X)=(7/2)^3 Tr X. Both rank-one projectors have trace 1; hence Tr P=Tr Q. Lambda is invertible and the underlying nonzero orthogonal projectors p,q differ, so P-Q is nonzero. It is Hermitian, and any nonzero traceless Hermitian matrix has both positive and negative eigenvalues. No numerical example or eigenvalue magnitude is used.
scope: All-variable symbolic consequence for the original same-pair d4 domain; no selected physical state, control, parameter or held guide.
nonclaims: Neither a q3 counterexample nor a proof of the required B†P^-1B<=Q. No claim is made about [P,Q], absolute spectral values, noncommuting B, approximate order, novelty, formal proof, independent review or parent adoption.
